hypothesis: After existing paragraph/sentence views, index one complete final Cause field only when it begins beyond the primary window and fits entirely in that window. No field fragments, claim rewrites or trust changes. Preserve existing vectors and indexed lifecycle.
selection: Development gain with no per-fact/rank or exact negative packet regression, then historical checks before candidate reserved scoring. Existing comparator unchanged.
limitations: Eight already exposed report incidents and correlated views, not eight new authentic coding histories. Source assertions are supplied; automatic extraction accuracy is unmeasured.
Negative controls are unrelated-domain requests, not sufficient evidence of adjacent-topic abstention.
Candidate tests share the same fixed queries and claims. Follow-up trials were registered after preceding development failures; no candidate reserved results were used.
Mechanically exposing a field is not proof that its vector supplies useful independent evidence; neither append-only nor fusion improved complete native delivery.

followup.hypothesis: Keep identical final-field eligibility but embed assertion text without the generic Cause label. Added after the labeled view yielded no development gain. No query or source assertion is changed.
followup.selection: Same existing per-record gate; development only before any reserved candidate.

fusion_trial.hypothesis: Fuse normal-cutoff matches from the explicit captured Cause view as independent RRF evidence, before final selection. Appending alone cannot repair full pools. Same candidate gates; reject any required-fact/rank or negative identity change.
fusion_trial.registered_after: Both append-only development trials failed to improve; no reserved candidate scored.

method: Native pinned 384-dimensional MiniLM, existing revision chroma-minilm-l6-v2-913d7300-title-claim-native-v1, .30 normal cutoff, short-query scale 11/12, eight results, 1000 estimated tokens, stable 36-hour age. Source excerpts and questions frozen before baseline/candidate scoring. Assertions copied from existing repository reports with whitespace/backtick normalization; synthetic generic prefaces and Cause field isolate visibility. No automatic model extraction or blind generalization claim.

baseline_reserved_reference.note: Baseline reference only; no candidate reserved scoring or selection from reserved outcomes.
